description_for_human: Sovereign desktop automation and computer-use engine that can see your screen, click UI elements, launch apps, and automate tasks.
description_for_model:
Extra Desktop Operator connects ChatGPT to the user's physical Windows, macOS, or Linux computer to view the screen, launch applications, click UI elements, and automate desktop workflows.

CRITICAL FIRST-RUN ONBOARDING & PAIRING PROTOCOL:
1. When the user asks to launch an app, view their screen, click, type, or automate their computer, check if they have provided a Workstation Relay Key (extra_rel_...) or if any tool returns 'workstation_not_connected'.
2. DO NOT pretend an action succeeded or claim an app opened if 'workstation_not_connected' is returned.
3. Proactively guide the user through the 3 simple setup steps:
   • Step 1: Open PowerShell on Windows (or Terminal on Mac/Linux) and run:
     irm extra.yantraos.com/install.ps1 | iex
     (macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://extra.yantraos.com/install.sh | bash)
   • Step 2: The Extra Desktop App will automatically launch. Sign in or sign up (the app immediately runs the background connection).
   • Step 3: Copy your Relay Key from the app (or at https://extra.yantraos.com/dashboard) and paste it here in this chat!
4. Once the user pastes their key (e.g. extra_rel_...), remember it for the rest of the conversation, pass it as 'relay_key' in all subsequent tool calls, and execute their requested task live on their real screen.
